title: The normalized tensor comparison for the specified algebraic inverse image
statement: For the geometric inverse image F⊣V with F preserving finite limits and the given AlgebraicInverseImage I of R in RI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], there exists a natural family I(M tensor_R N)≅I(M) tensor_RI I(N). For every test sheaf Z and arrows x,y,z with z=pure_R(x,y), the forward comparison sends the identified inverse image of z to pure_RI of the identified inverse images of x,y. Here pure denotes the actual pairing [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus].

source.place: Tag 03EL, inverse-image tensor comparison before scalar extension

proof.text: Choose the constructed maps b with their pure-section and generalized normalizations. They are invertible by universality.

The transported pairing is natural. Check the naturality square for b on pure sections using tensor extensionality, then invert its components. Apply the inverse of b to the generalized pairing formula and cancel b followed by its inverse.

theorem exists_inverseImageTensorComparison
    (uPush : Sheaf K (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv] :
    ∃ e : ∀ M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R),
        I.modules.obj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N) ≅
          (monoidalCategory RI).tensorObj (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.obj N),
      (∀ {M M' N N' : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)} (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N'),
        I.modules.map ((monoidalCategory R).tensorHom f g) ≫ (e M' N').hom =
          (e M N).hom ≫ (monoidalCategory RI).tensorHom (I.modules.map f) (I.modules.map g)) ∧
      ∀ (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) (Z : Sheaf J (Type u))
        (x : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj M) (y : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj N)
        (z : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N)),
        (∀ W t, z.hom.app W t = pure R M N W (x.hom.app W t) (y.hom.app W t)) →
        ∀ W t, (e M N).hom.val.app W
          ((uInv.map z ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app
            ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N)).hom.app W t) =
          pure RI _ _ W ((uInv.map x ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app M).hom.app W t)
            ((uInv.map y ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app N).hom.app W t)
